conclusion: No statistically significant difference between LinUCBPolicy (baseline) and LinUCBPolicy (candidate) for the 'reduced_context_features' ablation (p=1.0000).
LinUCBPolicy (baseline) performed significantly better in the 'alternative_reward_definitions' ablation (p=0.0003, effect size=-0.7498).
LinUCBPolicy performed significantly better in the 'random_critic_selection' ablation (p=0.0000, effect size=-3.9881).
